summary: Independently reviewed both editions against every clause of the selected Greek, including their notes and decision metadata. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the offenses, forgiveness scope and conditions, whole-hearted repentance and removal of double-mindedness, the no-salvation warning and distinct repentance limits, the difficult negative about denying life, and the distinction between impending denial and mercy already shown to previous deniers. The simplified edition retains these independently of its agreement with the standard. The witness notes are compatible with the supplied bounded reports and distinguish editorial emendations, correctors, and mediated Ethiopic evidence from preserved readings. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the supplied working source and disclosure of the supplied reports; it does not authenticate unseen prints, manuscript handwriting, or exhaustive collation.
